about_short_description.short_description: Plura is a global developer of multi-function 4k/UHD/FHD monitoring and timing/synchronization systems with outstanding performance.

product.name: SFP-25G-H Monitor Series
product.description: Portable broadcast and media monitors supporting uncompressed UHD up to 4096x2160 resolution with 25GbE IP connectivity and hybrid SDI/IP interfaces.

product.name: SFP-25G Monitor Series
product.description: Broadcast and media monitors with TRUE-IP 25GbE connectivity supporting uncompressed UHD video and hybrid SDI/IP interfaces for professional media monitoring.

product.name: PBM-4K Monitor Series
product.description: Multi-format 4K/UHD capable monitors supporting HDR, SMPTE standards, and hybrid SDI/IP inputs for broadcast and professional video production.

product.name: PRM-317-3G Reference Broadcast Monitor
product.description: 17" reference monitor with UHD 10-bit panel supporting up to 3G 1080P resolutions, waveform, vector scope, and upgrade options for 4K and IP monitoring.

product.name: PRM-224-3G-O OLED Broadcast Monitor
product.description: 24.5" OLED broadcast monitor with 10-bit panel, HDR support, fast response time, high contrast, and accurate color reproduction for HD and SD monitoring.

product.name: RUB-C3 PTP Timing Module
product.description: PTP Slave or Grandmaster module conforming to SMPTE 2059-2 and IEEE 1588-2008 standards for precise timing and synchronization in broadcast systems.
